title: Minor Update 1.2.1
summary: A minor update with big Family Library improvements, faster exports, a Revision Manager addition and general bug fixes.
content:
Family Library
Major improvements, all within the extension:
• Edit families loaded into your project.
• Redirect where a family file is saved.
• Select all in project.
• Edit family thumbnails, tags, file names and type names.

Expert Sheets
Improved export speed.

Revision Manager
Added Create New Revision Sequence.

General Bug Fixes
• Revit 2023 failing to launch Expert Sheets: resolved.
• Unable to export sheets with missing parameters: fixed.
• ReNumber integer 48 error: fixed.
• View Creator (beta): alignment updated.
